task_contract.goal: Return every matching record pair, not a top-k approximation. The match predicate can legitimately accept multiple targets per source.

symbols.K: number of true matching pairs emitted

task_contract.brute_force_route: An existing router permits brute-force pair evaluation exactly when N*M <= 10000; above that it must use a bounded alternative or report that the exact task cannot meet budget.
task_contract.logical_billing_unit: One complete reconciliation job; also report per source record. Changing batch size does not change the denominator.
task_contract.quality: Preserve all true matches or explicitly mark the run incomplete. Candidate pruning needs recall evidence. Streaming the complete result is permitted.

group_contract: group_classes is a compact run-length representation of independent groups, not raw input records. Only records in the same group can match. Within each group, every source/target pair remains a candidate before evaluating the predicate.
measurements: No runtime or model usage has been measured. Token limits are requirements, not observed token counts.
